methodology.literal: Quoted direct .rpc first argument, including erased TypeScript assertions.
methodology.finite: Explicit literal/conditional values in reviewed local/typed dispatchers and resolver whitelists; per-site provenance is retained.
methodology.generic: Nonliteral .rpc sites remain listed. Finite values observed at callers do not close an exported dispatcher globally.

limitations: Source extraction is a balanced lexical scan, not a TypeScript control-flow proof or a complete dependency graph.

Literal names are recorded at direct .rpc calls; finite values also include reviewed local helper dispatch branches and explicit typed dispatcher constants. Observed finite values are not all proved reachable runtime RPC targets.
Dynamic first arguments remain explicitly listed even where known local callers contribute finite values. Exported/generic dispatchers may accept additional values outside these source roots.
Exact source revision and observation times differ. Uncommitted new Assessment work is deliberately excluded.
A catalog name match does not establish matching named arguments, compatible payload/return DTOs, authorization, runtime behavior, HTTP Auth/RLS acceptance, browser acceptance, or clinical release.

Table and column metadata are read without clinical rows, defaults, policy expressions, function bodies, or keys. Advisor summaries describe the whole project; relevant findings are filtered by this catalog scope.
This broader source scope is not directly comparable to the historical 145-literal / 57-present audit. No progress percentage is calculated.
